description: This file defines a DialogFragment in an Android application that displays a list of apps for the user to select and pin to the home screen. It includes a callback interface for handling app selection and manages an adapter to display the apps in a GridView.

classes.name: AppPickedCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback invoked when an app is selected.

classes.name: PinnedAppPickerDialog
classes.description: Dialog fragment allowing users to pick an app to pin.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PinnedAppPickerDialog with specified adapter and callback.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the dialog.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the GridView with adapter and item click handler.
